Mega Menu Animation

Web,Fintech,Cinematicby @gabriell_lab2026-08-30inspora pageoriginal post

What it is

Fintech marketing site ('Grain') nav with a mega menu: hovering Products drops a wide panel with a 2-column feature link list and a sunset image card, over a blurred golden-hour hero; panel opens with fade+settle and closes cleanly.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-15%
Closed: slim nav (Grain wordmark; Products/Resources/Compliance with carets) over a blurred warm landscape hero with 'Built for Modern Payments' headline.
15-30%
Products hover: mega panel appears below nav - white/translucent card spanning content width, opacity 0->1, translateY -8px->0 with ease-out.
30-70%
Panel open: left column feature links with icons (Stablecoin Checkout, Virtual Accounts, Cross-Border Transfers), right column secondary links (Links, Invoicing, Connect), far-right sunset image card with caption; individual items highlight on hover.
70-90%
Pointer leaves: panel fades and lifts back out (~200ms), nav carets rotate back.
90-100%
Closed state restored.

Mechanics

trigger
hover/focus on nav item
elements
nav bar, mega panel (link columns + image card), caret icons
properties
panel opacity + translateY, caret rotation, item hover backgrounds
timing
open 250ms ease-out, close 180ms ease-in, ~150ms intent delay before open
easing
ease-out open / ease-in close
loop
demo opens and closes

Build prompt

Build a mega-menu nav. Bar: wordmark left, 3 items with carets, transparent over a blurred hero image. On hover/focus of Products (with 150ms open intent delay, 300ms close grace so diagonal pointer moves don't flicker): panel renders full content-width below the bar - translucent white card, blur backdrop, radius 16, border black/5, shadow-xl. Enter: opacity 0->1 + translateY -8px->0 over 250ms ease-out; caret rotates 180deg. Interior: 3-column grid - col 1: three feature links (32px icon tile, bold title, 2-line description), col 2: three plain links with arrow icons, col 3: 4:3 image card with caption. Row hover: bg black/4, 8px radius, 120ms. Exit: 180ms ease-in fade + -4px lift. Keyboard: focus opens, Esc closes, focus returns to trigger. Mobile: accordion instead.
